pitch.heading: Up the fell road to Gaunt
pitch.text: The march road brings you up out of the snow-fields to a stone cross where the fell road begins: north over Carth Fell, and down across the white Levels to Gaunt, the walled city of the Minster, three days before the Fast. On the step of the Cross a barefoot old man is mending a sandal he does not need, and beside him a beadle sits with his frozen foot in his hat.
